    "poc:dossier": "node scripts/check_generator_install.mjs && npm run build:poc --silent && node apps/three-surface-poc/dist/polaris-generation/dossier-main.js",
    "poc:generator-demo": "node scripts/check_generator_install.mjs && npm run build:poc --silent && node apps/three-surface-poc/dist/polaris-generation/pipeline-demo-main.js",
